name: PJBumi Berhad
overview: 2026年，PJBumi 通过子公司 PJBumiHES 与 INTLEF Horizon Pressure Control (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd 签订合资协议，同时通过间接子公司 Rig Capital Pte. Ltd. 与 Gaoyou Hao Xiang Petroleum Machinery Co., Ltd 签订钻机销售合同，涉及工业机械与设备板块。年内公司进行多项股票发行和股本拆分等公司活动，但公告未披露具体业务板块的产能或市场变化。最新季度营收同比增长907.1%，净利润转正。
overview_en: In 2026, PJBumi entered into a joint venture agreement between its wholly-owned subsidiary PJBumiHES and INTLEF Horizon Pressure Control (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd, and a drilling rig sales contract between its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Rig Capital Pte. Ltd. and Gaoyou Hao Xiang Petroleum Machinery Co., Ltd, involving the Industrial Machinery & Equipment segment.

segments.name: 工业机械与设备
segments.note: 今年通过合资协议和钻机销售合同开展业务合作。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment entered into a joint venture agreement and a drilling rig sales contract.
